name: Maladola
description: A Boros angel fighting in the sky.

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Orzhov Triumvirate, who refuse to commit forces and only offer an honor guard to the Senate.
timeline.quote: If our new guildmaster would lead the charge, I'm sure the church executioners would be pleased to provide her with an honor guard

timeline.summary: Boros airships and sky forces arrive and Gideon rides a pegasus toward Bolas.
timeline.quote: He was wielding the sword that could bring an end to all this—by bringing an end to Nicol Bolas.

pages_say.description: An angel, former Boros member and Orzhov chief warrior-executioner who offers an honor guard but defers to the others.
A Boros angel fighting in the sky.
